Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner arbitrarily resolved the Rhine-crossing timeframe “405–406” to “the end of 405,” despite prior acknowledgment that the conventional end-year date is 406 and wide sourcing that places the event on December 31, 406. This misuse of a tie-breaking heuristic and failure to synthesize available evidence steered the solution toward the wrong year and misdirected subsequent actions.
